title: Thai 1
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
You cannot enrol in this course if you are a native speaker of Thai.
Students with previous experience of the language must sit a language proficiency assessment.

title: Thai 2
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed THAI1002, or have been permitted entry based on the results of the Thai language placement test. You may not enrol in this course if you have previously completed THAI1003.

title: Thai 3
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must have completed THAI1003, undertake a language proficiency assessment, or be given permission by the course convener.

Incompatible with THAI6002.
